“You know, to just be grossly generalistic, you could put half of Trump’s supporters into what I call the basket of deplorables.
The racist, sexist, homophobic, xenophobic, Islamophobic — you name it.
And unfortunately there are people like that.
And he has lifted them up.
He has given voice to their websites that used to only have 11,000 people — now 11 million.
He tweets and retweets their offensive, hateful, mean-spirited rhetoric.
Now some of those folks — they are irredeemable, but thankfully they are not America.
